component.name: SideSave
component.summary: Peer-to-peer save sync for non-Steam Steam shortcuts

developer.name: bytethecookie, forked from OpenSave by Siva Prakash & contributors

description.p: SideSave keeps save data in sync across every device you play on — PC, laptop, Steam Deck — for games added to Steam as a non-Steam shortcut. Those saves aren't covered by Steam Cloud (that only syncs real Steam-store games), which is the gap this exists to fill. It watches your save folders, snapshots them the moment a game writes, and syncs devices directly over LAN or through a relay — no accounts, no server.

ul.li: Identifies non-Steam shortcuts by their real name, read straight from Steam's own shortcuts.vdf
Per-game snapshots with one-click restore and branching
Direct device-to-device sync with content-based conflict detection
Optional cloud mirroring to Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive
Steam Deck aware: finds saves inside Proton prefixes and on SD cards

description.p: A fork of OpenSave, narrowed to just this one job — see the project README for what changed and why.
